title: Recap: -andó / -endő (you know it from B1 Unit 27)

sections.title: Formation and Meaning of -andó / -endő
sections.content: You know the participle *-andó / -endő* from B1 Unit 27. In formal legal, historical, and administrative Hungarian, it *-andó / -endő* expresses necessity, obligation, or an action to be performed: *megoldandó feladat* ('a task to be solved'), *követendő példa* ('an example to be followed'), *elvégzendő munka* ('work that must be carried out').

items.spanish: Az ország újjáépítése az 1920-as években sürgősen megoldandó feladat volt.
items.english: In the 1920s the reconstruction of the country was a task that had to be solved urgently.

items.spanish: A miniszterelnök kijelölte a kormány által követendő politikai irányvonalat.
items.english: The Prime Minister indicated the political guideline to be followed by the government.
